Fashion Sampling, Pattern Cutting & Garment Development in London The Sampling Studio is an independent fashion development and garment manufacturing studio based in the heart of East London, where creativity, craftsmanship and technical expertise come together. With over 50 years of combined industry experience, our team has worked with some of fashion’s most recognised names, including Burberry, Acne Studios, Erdem, Victoria Beckham and Galia Lahav, as well as emerging designers and independent luxury labels. Specialising in pattern cutting, toile development, sampling and garment production, we work closely with designers at every stage of the creative process. From the first concept to the final garment, our approach combines traditional craftsmanship with a contemporary understanding of fashion, construction and innovation.
